study.question: Does the residual frozen full-minus-blind action gap depend on the zero initialization of the exact-mask membership representation under the frozen single-pass recipe?
study.hypothesis: The residual gap may partly reflect categorical representation initialization rather than historical action information beyond masks. The full frozen arm begins with nonconstant action vectors, whereas the blind frozen arm begins with their constant mean and a zero membership table. Giving the existing membership table a nonconstant, sample-independent, action-RMS-scaled initialization may preferentially improve the blind arm. This is a finite-recipe optimization hypothesis, not a claim that actions are determined by masks.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the entire frozen-action model and surrogate VJP. Change only the existing membership-table initial values; cross with full versus blind action use.
Closest blind control already has exact mask access; its zero initialization is the unresolved representation alternative.
Archived primary abstract describes candidate-conditioned local activation. That component is inherited; no original DIN reproduction or new pooling claim.
Pinned benchmark forward uses task masks for sequence hub initialization. This supports checking an alternative mask information path; no hubs or broadcasts are adopted.
Pinned benchmark forward adds action and item embeddings. This study changes initialization in the local lineage rather than adopting its sequential transduction.

Pinned implementation defaults to Gaussian feature embeddings with std=1e-4. The intervention matches the actual initialized action-table centered RMS, without assuming that default scale or altering host initialization.

inherited_components: Strongest visible lineage g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative; later explicit exact-mask membership and frozen-action controls from g0-r0087.
All representations, action-aware scorer, task adapters, forward paths, true-label losses, optimizer ownership and surrogate context-transfer backward.
Existing learnable nn.Embedding(16,16), ordinary unshared action table and RNG-isolated appended initialization.
study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 factorial: full/blind action use crossed with zero/action_rms membership initialization, always with action gradients blocked. action_rms reuses the membership Embedding constructor Gaussian draw, centers its 16 rows, and rescales their overall RMS to that of centered initial nonpadding action rows. It does not decode actions, fit a mapping, read sample actions, add state or change forward/backward methods. Both new cells receive identical membership initialization. All 16 patterns, including valid pattern zero, are initialized and remain learnable.
predictions: The zero bridges should reproduce g0-r0087-full_frozen AUC 0.6688987894457554 and g0-r0087-blind_frozen AUC 0.6680388350151792 within host reproducibility tolerance; exact repeated seed is a bridge only.

If zero initialization contributes materially, Delta_initialized=(AUC_full_initialized-AUC_blind_initialized) will be smaller than Delta_zero, with improved blind AUC rather than merely degraded full AUC.

Predeclared diagnostic screening signal: blind improvement at least 0.0004, gap attenuation at least 0.0004, and full AUC decrease no more than 0.0002. These pragmatic thresholds are approximately half and one quarter of the prior 0.000860 gap; they are not significance or equivalence thresholds.

All four variants should have identical allocated parameter counts and checkpoint shapes; new initialization adds only construction-time work, with no added inference operator. Host runtime still must be measured.
falsifiers: If the initialized blind arm does not improve or the full-minus-blind gap is stable/larger, this particular initialization explanation is unsupported; it does not prove conditional action information or refute all representation explanations.
If the gap shrinks only because full deteriorates beyond the declared tolerance, do not claim the blind representation recovered useful signal.

A zero centered action-table RMS, mismatched paired initial states, altered RNG continuation, nonzero action-table gradients, changed padding/target behavior or failed bridge invalidates this implementation contrast.
Without measured action/mask joint support and informative within-row variation, do not interpret previous cyclic or conditional-mean controls as evidence against event-aligned residual information.
alternative_explanations: Random mask geometry is not action geometry: scalar RMS matching does not match covariance, frequency-weighted scale or distances.
One fixed training seed cannot establish equivalence, significance or seed robustness.
Finite-pass nonlinear optimization and surrogate context updates can amplify small initial changes.
Action-to-mask injectivity and within-row heterogeneity remain unmeasured: optional diagnostics were not requested in prior receipts.
Membership initializer creates class separation but also changes total action-channel variance in the full arm; the factorial exposes interaction but does not remove this geometry confound.
Global support injectivity does not follow from source token-to-mask construction; distinct action tokens could collapse to the same mask pattern.

observation_review.scope: Own-arm validation only; every visible trajectory retained, including unsuccessful removals. No withheld information.
interpretation: Action blind removal without direct mask access fell from 0.668961 to 0.643478; counts alone recovered 0.661608. These contrasts conflate action information with mask representation.
Direct mask membership raised blind AUC to 0.667859, close to full+membership 0.668847. This is substantial recovery, not proof that masks exhaust action information.

Global counts+membership AUC 0.668357 lagged full, while conditional counts+membership 0.668876 was similar to full 0.668847. Missing joint-support and changed-event diagnostics prevent an alignment conclusion.

Blocking action-codebook learning retained a full/blind gap of 0.0008599544 compared with native 0.0009886417. It weakens an explanation solely through action-table adaptation but leaves geometry and downstream optimization open.

Repeated bridge AUCs at the same fixed seed are execution reproducibility evidence only. All visible trials succeeded; absence of other failures from the scoped context is not evidence that none occurred elsewhere.

validation_plan.local: Parse/compile source without importing torch; validate study schema and config/source consistency; verify bridge hashes and AST preservation of all methods except __init__. No data, forward/backward or training execution locally.
host_prerequisites: Verify the pinned data/protocol/readiness receipts before research execution. Raw parquet files and training runtime are not exposed in this coding context.

Use the authorized host interface only. Instantiate all four under the frozen seed; check inherited weights, downstream buffers and host RNG continuation match, with only membership initial values differing. Initial full and blind predictions need not match.

For action_rms: nonzero finite centered action RMS; centered membership RMS equal within FP32 tolerance; identical member weights in the paired new arms; identical action table in all arms. All state-dict shapes and parameter counts must match.

Run forward/backward, finite four-probability/loss, empty-history, padding invariance and target-action invariance tests. In the blind path, changing historical action IDs with masks fixed must not change predictions. Action-table gradient is absent/zero; membership gradients remain finite and reachable. These are host tests, not executed here.

Aggregate existing membership_diagnostics joint_counts and cycle changed events/rows over authorized training support only, with all cost charged. Report observed stratum/action support, no fabricated injectivity. No within-row variation means the earlier cycle is uninformative. Optional diagnostic methods require explicit host invocation; this proposal does not create an automatic collector.
validation_plan.analysis: Use all 2871767 validation impressions. Report four-task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary AUC separately; click selects. Tabulate parameters, allocated GPU time, train/wall time, examples, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 batch latency. Report both simple initialization effects, both action gaps and their difference in differences. Report history bins with n/positive/negative counts; additional unavailable slices/paired user-bootstrap are omissions, not invented estimates.

If user-cluster paired predictions/identities become available through a granted host analysis interface, use paired user bootstrap; they are not model inputs.
